name: overwatch-training-tracker
description: Zero-dependency client-side tracker for a structured Overwatch training program. Program content lives in program.json and is editable in-app.

scripts.check:js: node --experimental-vm-modules -e "for (const f of ['state','ui','pages','editor','main']) new (require('module').Module) {}" 2>/dev/null; for f in js/*.js; do node --check <(sed 's/^import .*//;s/^export //' $f) >/dev/null 2>&1 || echo "syntax issue: $f"; done; echo js-checked
